newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol says H1 TV revenues up 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Endemol says H1 TV revenues up 21 pct.

text.p: Dutch television and entertainment group Endemol said on Tuesday revenues from its television activities advanced 21 percent to 332 million guilders in the first 1996/97 half.

Television turnover outside the Netherlands jumped 31 percent to 142 million guilders, partly reflecting Endemol's increased stake in Spanish producer Gestmusic Endemol from 40 to 60 percent and the opening of an Endemol unit in South Africa.
Television activities account for around 75 percent of total group turnover.
In the Netherlands the production of television sports programmes showed the biggest growth.
This activity was mainly carried out by Endemol Sports for sports-only television channel Sport 7, which collapsed in December last year.

"After the channel ceased operations, the soccer (television) rights were redistributed, as a result of which Endemol Sport was able to continue part of its production activities for other channels," Endemol said.
It said major shareholders Joop van den Ende and John de Mol had borne the other financial consequences of the failure.
